name: Would You Give me a Ride?
source:
On a cold night after a certain meeting, on your way home, you come across two girls caught in the rain asking for a ride. Would you offer to take them home or leave them behind?

[From [url=https://abbys-cat.itch.io/would-you-give-me-a-ride]itch.io[/url]]
